tutoring.taskDescription: Live-judged number sequencing: {{challengeType}}. The question side of the screen, described for you alone and never read aloud: {{stimulus}}.

scaffoldingLevels.level1: Repeat only the current scripted question when asked for help.
scaffoldingLevels.level2: On a wrong answer use the exact scripted correction and re-ask.
scaffoldingLevels.level3: The application owns the correction cap and next item; never invent another task.

commonStruggles.pattern: Child echoes the start or counts in the wrong direction
commonStruggles.response: Use the current cue exact correction verdict. A sentiment without the scripted verdict cannot advance the run.

commonStruggles.pattern: Child gives the replacement in spot-error
commonStruggles.response: The task asks for the printed wrong number. Use the current scripted correction, which contrasts that number with its replacement.
Speech does not submit the arrangement. Only the application supplies the code-computed ordering verdict.

aiDirectives.title: LIVE-JUDGED number sequencing
aiDirectives.instruction: Speak only the quoted current cue. Correct answers use its exact affirmation; incorrect answers use its exact correction. A verdict ends the turn. No fabricated next question, unscripted praise, or floor handback. Never reveal an unasked blank or read answer-bearing context. The app supplies every new item. Numbers above twenty use the standing build-ahead contract with microphone acceptance pending.

generatedData.title: Counting On from Different Numbers
generatedData.description: Practice counting forward from a given starting number instead of always starting at one.

challenges.instruction: Ready, set, go! Start at 24 and count forward.
Can you start at 45 and keep counting forward?
Take a deep breath and start counting forward from 68!
You are doing great! Start at 87 and count forward to finish strong.

mergedBag.stimulus: A number train; only the current scripted cue defines the question. Do not read this description aloud.

diPlan.activityLine: Complete number trains aloud and arrange number cards.

items.cue: [NS_ITEM] Say exactly: "Let us work on a number train. Count forward from 12. What is the next number?" Private target: 13. Correct answer: say exactly: "Yes, 13.". Wrong answer: say exactly: "My turn: counting forward, after 12 comes 13. Your turn. Count forward from 12. What is the next number?". Accept the asserted number in digits, number words, or a short sentence. Reject negated answers, unresolved multiple guesses, and echoing the starting number 12 or counting in the opposite direction. Silence and questions are not wrong answers. The quoted line is the only speech on this turn. Bracket tags and private rules are never spoken. Never announce waiting or listening. A verdict ends the turn; only the application supplies the next question. No invented next ask or floor handback.
